items.title: Notepad++ Hosting Breach Attributed to China-Linked Lotus Blossom Hacking Group
items.description: A China-linked threat actor known as Lotus Blossom has been attributed with medium confidence to the recently discovered compromise of the infrastructure hosting Notepad++. The attack enabled the state-sponsored hacking group to deliver a previously undocumented backdoor codenamed Chrysalis to users of the open-source editor, according to new findings from Rapid7. items.title: Notepad++ Hack Detailed Along With the IoCs and Custom Malware Used
items.description: A sophisticated espionage campaign attributed to the Chinese Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) group Lotus Blossom (also known as Billbug). The threat actors compromised the infrastructure hosting the popular text editor Notepad++ to deliver a custom, previously undocumented backdoor named “Chrysalis”.
